```yaml
name: Benchmarks

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - trunk
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  run-benchmarks:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Run benchmarks
        id: bench
        run: |
          chmod +x bench.sh
          ./bench.sh > bench_output.json
          echo "BENCH_JSON=$(cat bench_output.json)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Write benchmark summary
        run: |
          echo "## Benchmark Results" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo '```json' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          cat bench_output.json >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo '```' >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY

      - name: Commit benchmark results to perf branch
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git fetch origin perf || true
          git checkout -B perf origin/perf || git checkout -b perf
          mkdir -p benchmarks
          cp bench_output.json benchmarks/benchmarks.json
          git add benchmarks/benchmarks.json
          git commit -m "Update benchmark results for commit ${{ github.sha }}"
          git push --force-with-lease origin perf
```
